We are seeking an Systems Admin 4 for a fixed-term, project-focused position supporting the new UC Davis CA Tower project. This is a full-time position with an anticipated end date on or before December 31, 2030, aligning with the projected completion of the CA Tower project. Employment in this position is directly tied to the lifecycle of the CA Tower project and is expected to conclude upon the project’s completion.
40% - Systems Design and Planning

The Sys Admin 4 will function as the subject matter expert for the Westcom nursecall system and will support the IT Facilities Technologies and IT Implementations project teams on the CA Tower project. Regarding the Westcom Nurse Call system, this position is responsible for the design review, standards development, commissioning, validation and acceptance testing, and development of user training materials for the Westcom nurse call system across the CA Tower project. This role serves as the technical authority on the CA Tower project for nurse call system design and quality assurance, ensuring all installations meet organizational standards, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory requirements, and project specifications. This incumbent collaborates with clinical stakeholders, architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, ITFT, IT Facilities, and project teams throughout the project lifecycle from planning through final system acceptance and user training.
20% - Acceptance Testing and Commissioning
20% - System Integration and Technical Leadership
20% - Quality Assurance and Compliance
